correctness.rationale: For the stated reversible finite-state process and the full joint even-orientation entropy-production definition, the Fokker--Planck entropy identity is exact: integrated jump currents vanish edgewise by detailed balance. Positive reversible autocovariance and linear Langevin dynamics bound the propulsion-position covariance by W and the position variance by (D+W)/kappa. The exact heat flux differs from (sigma²+u² exp(-2 kappa t))/D by at most kappa(2W+D)/D at every positive time. Gaussian convolution and maximum-entropy bounds confine joint entropy to a bounded interval across each scaled time window. Time integration proves the precise stated O(kappa) inequality and limit. The supplied standard-library checker passes finite diagnostics but cannot replace the analytic argument.
